entities.summary: The Saint Nicholas Cathedral, also known as the Ruski Krstur Cathedral, is an Eastern Catholic church located in Ruski Krstur, Kula, Serbia. It is under jurisdiction of the Greek Catholic Eparchy of Ruski Krstur of the Greek Catholic Church of Croatia and Serbia and serves as its cathedral church. The church was elevated in cathedral in 2003, simultaneously with the creation of the Apostolic Exarchate for Catholics of Byzantine rite of Serbia under the pontificate of Pope John Paul II.
